card.name: Ability to swallow tablets or capsules
card.fires_on: The word swallow (or swallowing) after phrases like "patients who can", "able to" or "unable to" in dosing instructions for tablets, capsules or soft food.

modes.label: Can swallow
modes.description: Swallow after "patients who can" when describing who may take whole tablets or capsules.
modes.example: For patients who can<< swallow>> whole capsules and whose doses are multiples of

modes.label: Unable to swallow
modes.description: Swallow or its split-off ending after "unable to", introducing an alternative way to give the dose.
modes.example: If a patient is unable to<< swallow>> the intact capsule(s), open the capsule

modes.label: Split word
modes.description: The ending of swallow when the word is split, as in headings about patients able or unable to swallow.
modes.example: Patients Able to Sw<<allow>> Capsules Administer ZOKINVY
